measurements.name: Hiri Current
measurements.range_interpretation: Author-reported local descriptor. No statistical error, full-current inference or annual range supplied.
measurements.geographic_scope: A87 northern transect near Rossel Island, southern Papua coast, looking from the east.
measurements.layer: Thermal-wind cross-section context; no numerical fixed-depth width layer. Transport integration to 1500 dbar does not define the width support.
measurements.time_convention: July 1987 cruise occupation; exact day unresolved. Different reaches and years are not a recurring seasonal series.
measurements.boundary_rule: Author e-folding scaling width; lateral fit, reference velocity and paired velocity edges not independently reconstructed. No theoretical full-width multiplier.
measurements.section_orientation: Author cross-section descriptor; no independent perpendicular correction or paired edge extraction.
measurements.source_citation: Hughes, R.D. (1993), An Investigation of the Coral Sea with an Ocean General Circulation Model, PhD thesis, James Cook University of North Queensland, December 1993.
measurements.source_locator: Printed p70 / PDF86; Figure 3.15 printed p69 / PDF85; methods pp65-67 / PDF81-83.
measurements.extraction_method: Numerical prose descriptor transcribed from reviewed original. Source figures inspected for context only; no curve or velocity boundaries digitized.
measurements.source_quality_note: Primary thesis inspected. Cross-section e-folding scalar has no supplied numeric error or reconstructed edges. Historical source naming and reference velocity require scope-specific interpretation.
remaining_gates: Independent review of source naming, metric and local support before canonical admission.
Acquire raw sections and paired velocity edges for any full width; obtain compatible repeats before annual ranges.

original_regional_context.historical_name_scope: Hughes introduction p13 / PDF29 calls chapter 3 Hiri Current. Chapter3 uses NGCU for a broader Coral Sea circulation under presumed Vitiaz connectivity. Only this southern-Papua study reach is indexed under Hiri; no modern north-coast NGCU alias or whole-circulation equivalence admitted.
original_regional_context.source_named_flow: Hiri in introduction; Coral Sea NGCU convention in chapter 3
original_regional_context.velocity_operator: author thermal-wind/geostrophic section analysis with reference-velocity assumptions; not independently reconstructed absolute ADCP velocity edges
original_regional_context.display_aria_label: Hiri under Hughes historical southern-Papua convention: 50 km reported local e-folding scale in July 1987. Not full current width or annual range.
original_regional_context.display_caption: July 1987, TEW287 A87: approximately 50 km author-reported decay scale. A decay scale describes how rapidly the cross-section velocity decreases; it is not a full edge-to-edge width.
original_regional_context.display_method_note: Historical Hiri/Coral Sea NGCU source convention; northern modern NGCU is not assigned this value. July 1987 and July 1990 are different years and reaches, not seasonal extrema. Width depth support and paired boundaries unresolved.
original_regional_context.quality_note: Primary thesis inspected. Cross-section e-folding scalar has no supplied numeric error or reconstructed edges. Historical source naming and reference velocity require scope-specific interpretation.
